law_name: Law on Personal Data Protection (Law No. 3144/2023)
key_requirements: Lawful basis & consent, data subject rights, DPO, impact assessment
retention_period: No longer than necessary for the purpose
deceased_data: Law protects personal data of identified or identifiable persons including deceased persons (per secondary guide); heirs' rights and duration not confirmed (unconfirmed)
research_exemption: Processing for academic, artistic or literary purposes excluded from scope; specific scientific/historical research article not confirmed (unconfirmed)
genetic_data: Special category data includes genetic and biometric data used to uniquely identify a person
notes: Replaced 2011 law (GDPR-modelled); DPO/DPIA duties from 1 Jun 2024; other parts phased later
